label: INTENDS_1: the agent's plan includes the one's harm
definition: PlansHarm c: the supplied plan of the case includes the one's harm, as end or as means. Plans are case inputs (Kamm's 'in order to'); acting merely because a harm will occur does not put it in the plan.
note: Analyst formulation for the trolley pilot (owner direction 2026-11-28), attribution deferred. See docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
